title: Dramatic Dialogue and Confrontation
goal: I can ask deliberative questions in the 1st person singular and plural subjunctive (Mit tegyek? Kihez forduljunk?)
I can express indignation or incredulity with echo subjunctive questions (Én kérjek bocsánatot?)
I can use B2 vocabulary of moral dilemma, confrontation, and stage conflict
